$comment: Pinned per-token rate catalog for the coder lanes the gym scorer prices.
Restored from the deleted packages/coder-effectiveness/src/pricing.ts
snapshot (commit 8703101286, deleted in fae80bde79). The rows are the
forge model catalog's integer micro-USD per million tokens converted to
USD per million tokens, and every row still carries the basis the forge
config gave it: operator_placeholder, a rate no operator has reconciled
against a provider invoice. The version string is unchanged from the
TypeScript snapshot because the rows are unchanged; bump it when a row
changes, because suiteKey pins it and rows priced against different
catalogs are not comparable.
ABSENT MODELS ARE ABSENT ON PURPOSE, and an absent rate prices as
unknown, never zero:
- gpt-5.6-luna is deliberately unpriced: the forge catalog omits pricing
for it so a grant pinned to it records no estimated cost rather than a
made-up zero. It is listed under deliberately_unpriced so the scorer
can tell 'the catalog refuses to price this' from 'never heard of it'.
- glm-5.3-flash (the native Coder Flash lane) has no entry because no
public list price for the lane serving it is known to this repo; its
rows stay cost_unknown until an operator lands a real rate here.
- Local ollama tags (qwen3.8:27b-mtp-q8_0, qwen3:0.6b, ...) never get
rows: the local lane bills no metered tokens, so there is no per-token
rate to be in the catalog. That is unmetered_local_lane, not free.
